ingredients.item: eggs, as fresh as you have

steps.text: Fill a deep pan with water, bring it to a bare simmer, and add the vinegar.
Crack each egg into a cup, then slide it into the water where it is moving.
Toast the sourdough and butter it right to the edges.
Lift the eggs out with a slotted spoon and rest them on a cloth to drain.
Sit them on the toast, season well, and eat them straight away.
